edits.new:
And every reconciliation_result row already written stays, and no migration is reversed because the sequence is forward only

  Scenario: AC7 The rules of section 8 hold in the deployment (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the deployment of the api and the worker and the route contract of section 8
    When the deployment is checked against each rule BR1 to BR12 of section 8
    Then the two deployments share one task queue and one schema, and neither touches another schema
    And the run is started by the event, and no Temporal Schedule, Quartz object or job-run table is created
    And SCR-45 is the composite route, and this service publishes no screen route
    And the flag is the only switch of the run, and the read serves the last completed business date while it is off
    And a break changes no Workbench record and no ACE row
    And the stale alert carries the product and its last complete business date and writes no stamp
    And the alerts and the dashboard count no business value of their own, and carry no personal data and no business key
    And the alert levels, the routing groups and the retention are configuration, and every environment deploys the same images

  Scenario: AC8 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the status model of the service as its source document gives it
    When a status change the model does not allow is requested
    Then the change is refused and the status of the record stays as it was
    And no other record changes
